mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, i.inventory_id, i.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) AS quantity, COALESCE(i.has_initial_stock, FALSE) AS has_initial_stock, il.type AS last_movement_type FROM product AS p LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN warehouse AS w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT inventory_id, type FROM inventory_log WHERE created_at = ( SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM inventory_log il2 WHERE il2.inventory_id = inventory_log.inventory_id ) ) AS il ON il.inventory_id = i.inventory_id ORDER BY has_initial_stock ASC, p.product_name;
